task_anchors.task_description: Comparing three vendor research proposals differing in price, session count, and deliverables to select an outside research partner under budget and time constraints.
Evaluating two contractor candidates' portfolios and documentation evidence to select who builds onboarding micro-interactions.
Interpreting an activation-metric change following a manual rules-engine adjustment, amid statistical and confounding limitations, and requesting expanded tuning authority.
Deciding whether to continue customizing a legacy wizard component or migrate to a new framework given known defects and prior sprint investment.

evidence: I got three vendor proposals in the same week... I ended up going with the twenty-three thousand one.
Two candidates were shortlisted... when the Head of Design asked for the testing basis, there wasn't really anything to show her.
I went to the Data lead and asked to expand my manual tuning authority... the causal driver was still unconfirmed.
I pushed to keep customizing the legacy component rather than migrate... the accessibility issue surfaced again during the pre-renewal QA pass.
